blockingIssues.description: Temporary benchmark instances derive service_name directly from HF repo IDs containing '/', and process PID/log paths use service_name as a filename stem. This can create invalid nested paths and prevent reliable startup for `mlx-stack bench <hf-repo>`.

appliedUpdates.description: Added a filesystem-safety constraint for dynamic service names to `.factory/library/architecture.md` under 'Operational Constraint: Service Name Safety'.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify expected evidence and enforcement for TDD-first ordering (failing test before implementation), or explicitly document acceptable exceptions for minimal scaffolding.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both `ungate-pull-command` and `fix-bench-hf-repo-target-resolution` reviews observed implementation edits before test additions while the skill still mandates strict test-first sequencing.
